messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — PrimeWave dedicated pool burn-in tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need quota plan, autoscale policy, and loadtest owners. Can we confirm? @ops_jake @infra_lee
ops_jake: I'm on it. What's the expected sustained RPS and p95 latency target?
maria_cs: Customer expects 400 qps sustained, 800 peak. Latency SLO 200ms p95. They've got reserved 8xA100s in us-west-2.
infra_lee: Confirmed 8xA100. Recommend autoscale min=8 max=16, scale step=2, cooldown=60s. Also want prefix/KV cache primed. Will we shadow traffic?
maria_cs: Yes, we'll shadow 30% of production traffic for 2h then bump. I'll send shadow template.
oncall_sam: I'll own the load test run. Can someone paste the load generator command? Also give the warmup token/keys.
infra_lee: Use our k6 script in repo: https://git.redwood/ops/load-scripts/primewave-k6.js. Command:
```bash
k6 run -e TARGET=https://primewave.redwood/api/generate -e QPS=400 primewave-k6.js
```
infra_lee: Use API key redacted (we'll add as secret). Also run KV priming job:
```bash
python scripts/kv_prime.py --pool primewave --rate 1000 --duration 600
```
ops_jake: For autoscale tests, we'll do stepped load: 200 -> 400 -> 800 qps, 15m per step. I'll post CSV with expected slot usage.
maria_cs: Sharing quota spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/primewave/quota-plan. Please update the 'Actuals' column during test.
deploy-bot: [scheduled] Dedicated pool burn-in slot reserved for PrimeWave on 2025-04-15 09:00 PT by maria_cs.
oncall_sam: Noted. I'll set a pager rotation and a small runbook:
```
Runbook:
- 08:30 PT: smoke test (50 qps)
- 08:45 PT: priming KV job
- 09:00 PT: start shadow 30%
- 10:00 PT: increase to target shadow 30% sustained
- 11:00 PT: ramp to peak for 20m
- 11:30 PT: cooldown and collect traces
```
maria_cs: Also reminder: collect customer feedback via the enablement survey link at end of session.
ops_jake: I'll record perf traces and upload to s3: s3://redwood-ops/primewave/burnin/1800123456/
infra_lee: Post-test checklist: priming complete, no OOMs, p95 < 200ms, error rate <0.5%. If fail, fallback to smaller variant (model-compat-4k).
oncall_sam: Acknowledged. Will run smoke 30m before with 50 qps.
maria_cs: Great — owners: ops_jake (load), infra_lee (infra), oncall_sam (monitoring). I'll run customer comms and enablement. :raised_hands:
ops_jake: All good. Ping me in thread when you start.
infra_lee: I'll push autoscale config to staging now and tag @maria_cs when ready.
maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll update the spreadsheet and post final go/no-go 1h before.
